name: Conditional follow-up — extend `.codx` ignore coverage to `api/.codx` and the repo-root `.codx` (only if M6 is accepted as docs-only)
description:
## Why this card exists

M6 (`8909f356`) produced `docs/.codx/.gitignore`, now committed on `main`. Measured 2026-11-19T08:52Z with `repository_overview()` (repo `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform`, branch `main`, ahead 6, dirty): the platform repo versions **three** control planes and the ignore file covers one.

| control plane | ignore file | tracked & modified today |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/.codx/` | yes (committed) | `autonomy/state.json`, `harness/audit.jsonl` — still in the index |
| `.codx/` (repo root) | no | `efforts/{agile,default,max}/*.effort` |
| `api/.codx/` | no | `autonomy/state.json`, `harness/audit.jsonl`, `browser_scripts/index.json`, `tasks/boards/{4d5d1727…,821b9558…}/board.json` |

## When to open it

**Only if** the Review on `8909f356` ratifies M6 as *docs control plane only*. If the review sends M6 back for a three-plane ignore file, this card is redundant — close it as `rejected` and quote that review comment.

## What to do

1. Copy `docs/.codx/.gitignore` to `api/.codx/.gitignore` and `.codx/.gitignore`, adjusting the invocation-root header (both copies are consumed from the platform root).
2. The `git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch` list for all three planes is already written on `82314f38` (comment 2026-11-19T08:52Z) — reuse it, do not re-derive it.
3. Keep `.codx/tasks/**` card JSONs unversioned-but-not-ignored? No: **keep them tracked**, as `docs/.codx/.gitignore` lines 23–24 decide (cards are the delivery record). Do not extend the card here.

## Acceptance

- `repository_overview()` after one full agent day on all three projects lists no `M` entry under `docs/.codx/{autonomy,harness}`, `.codx/efforts`, `api/.codx/{autonomy,harness,browser_scripts,tasks/boards}`.
- `security_audit(path=".codx")` returns allow, or every remaining finding has a reachable `path:line`.
- Rollback documented in the comment: `git reset --soft HEAD~1 && git reset -- docs/.codx api/.codx .codx`.
